deploy.instructions: Does merging this PR change anything that ends up in a built image or on the production server? Use `files` for what changed and `diff` for how. compose.yaml builds from three contexts: nginx/, front-ze/ and the repo root (the backend, via the root Dockerfile), and deployment/deploy-scripts.sh also git-pulls the repo on the server. Paths that need a deploy: src/, front-ze/, nginx/, pfp-provider/, serde_macros/, qgis-server/, Dockerfile, Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock, compose*.yaml, deployment/, redis.conf, db.sql, default.env, assets/. Paths that do not: *.md, LICENSE, .github/. Comment-only edits anywhere, including inside src/, do not need a deploy. A PR that mixes both needs a deploy. If `diff_truncated` is true and `files` lists deploy paths, it needs a deploy.

criteria.true: At least one change alters built code, configuration, assets or deployment behaviour.
criteria.false: Every change is documentation, CI config, or comments, so production would be byte-for-byte the same.

labels.name: bug
labels.instructions: Does this PR fix a bug, i.e. correct behaviour that was wrong? Judge from `title`, `body` and `diff`.

criteria.true: It corrects incorrect behaviour, a crash, or an error.
criteria.false: It adds, restructures or documents without fixing anything broken.

labels.name: enhancement
labels.instructions: Does this PR add a new user-facing feature or capability, such as a new endpoint, page, option or visualisation? Judge from `title`, `body` and `diff`.

criteria.true: Users or API clients can do something they could not before.
criteria.false: No new capability; it only fixes, refactors, documents or maintains.

labels.name: documentation
labels.instructions: Does this PR change documentation, such as *.md files, CLAUDE.md, README, or substantial doc comments? Use `files` and `diff`.

labels.name: refactor
labels.instructions: Is a substantial part of this PR restructuring, deduplicating, renaming or removing dead code while keeping behaviour the same? Judge from `title`, `body` and `diff`.

criteria.true: Significant code is reorganised or removed with behaviour intended to stay the same.
criteria.false: Changes are mainly new behaviour, fixes, docs or config.

labels.name: performance
labels.instructions: Is a stated or evident goal of this PR to improve speed, memory, query cost, caching, bundle size or load time? Judge from `title`, `body` and `diff`.

criteria.true: It targets performance, e.g. caching, query or index tuning, batching, streaming, lazy loading.
criteria.false: Performance is not a goal of the change.

labels.name: security
labels.description: Touches authentication, authorisation or a vulnerability
labels.instructions: Does this PR change authentication, authorisation, tokens, sessions, permission checks, player anonymisation/privacy, input sanitisation, or fix a vulnerability? Use `files` and `diff`.

criteria.true: Security- or privacy-relevant logic is changed.
criteria.false: No security- or privacy-relevant logic is touched.

labels.name: dependencies

labels.instructions: Does this PR add, remove or change the version of a dependency in Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock, front-ze/package.json, front-ze/bun.lock, or a Dockerfile base image? Use `files` and `diff`.

criteria.true: A dependency or base image is added, removed or changes version.

labels.name: rust
labels.description: Pull requests that update rust code
labels.instructions: Does this PR change Rust backend code, i.e. *.rs files under src/ or serde_macros/, or Cargo.toml? Use `files`.

labels.name: javascript

labels.instructions: Does this PR change frontend code under front-ze/, such as .ts, .tsx, .js or .css files or package.json? Use `files`.

labels.instructions: Does this PR change the database schema (db.sql), add or alter SQL queries (sqlx query!/query_as! macros or raw SQL), or change materialised views, triggers or pg_cron jobs? Use `files` and `diff`.

labels.name: ci

labels.name: infrastructure

labels.instructions: Does this PR change deployment or infrastructure: Dockerfiles, compose*.yaml, nginx/, deployment/, redis.conf, qgis-server/, replication/, default*.env? Use `files`.

criteria.false: No infrastructure or deployment files change.
